gap_analysis.primary_gap_reason: Our island models output raw tree probabilities (predict_proba) without post-hoc calibration. Trees are notoriously miscalibrated — they output overconfident probabilities near 0/1 boundaries.
gap_analysis.secondary_gap: No explicit uncertainty quantification — we treat each prediction as a point estimate rather than a distribution

proposals.name: Isotonic Regression Calibration Wrapper
proposals.effort: LOW — 3 lines of code change per island
proposals.description: Wrap GA-selected models with sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=3). Isotonic regression corrects for overconfidence at probability extremes. Training data: same fold used for Brier evaluation.

implementation.change: In features/engine.py or island app.py: after model.fit(), wrap: model = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, method='isotonic', cv='prefit'); model.fit(X_cal, y_cal)
implementation.validation: Compare ECE (Expected Calibration Error) pre/post. ECE should drop from ~0.08 to ~0.03.
implementation.risk: Low — calibration only affects probability output, not feature selection. Worst case: marginal degradation (revert easily).
implementation.cpu_cost: Minimal — calibration is O(N log N) for isotonic, runs in <1s on 9551 games.

proposals.name: Rolling Form Indicator Features
proposals.effort: MEDIUM — new feature category in engine.py
proposals.description: SOTA papers emphasize rolling 5/10/20 game windows for team offensive/defensive ratings, net rating momentum, and home/away split momentum. Our engine likely has rolling features but explicit momentum features (slope of last-5 vs last-20 rating) may be missing.

implementation.add_to: features/engine.py — new category 'team_momentum_indicators' (category 55 if v3.1 has 54)

proposals.name: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as GA Fitness Objective
proposals.description: Add ECE as third optimization objective in NSGA-II alongside Brier and ROI/Sharpe. Models with low Brier AND low ECE represent well-calibrated predictions — better for Kelly sizing.

implementation.change: In island app.py fitness(): compute ECE with 10 bins. Add to Pareto objectives: minimize [brier, ece, -sharpe]
implementation.formula: ECE = sum_b (n_b/N) * |avg_confidence_b - accuracy_b| for 10 equal-width probability bins

recommended_order: P1 (calibration wrapper) — ship to one island (S15, fleet best candidate) as A/B test
P2 (momentum features) — add to engine.py v3.2 after P1 validated
P3 (ECE objective) — ship after P1+P2 prove calibration benefit
